cards.title: Projector-phase accumulation
cards.role: Defines the subset-zeta map from projector phases to basis-state phases.

checks.reason: The accumulation rule is explicit in Eqs. (4)-(6) and Appendix A.
The executable zeta map reconstructs every one of the 256 Boolean phase tables on three variables.

cards.title: Subset-lattice Möbius inverse
cards.role: Recovers genuine k-body projector phases from a local phase table.

checks.reason: The inverse and cancellation proof are explicit in the source.
All 256 three-variable 0/pi phase tables invert and reconstruct with zero wrapped error.

cards.title: 3-SAT violating-pattern projector
cards.role: Turns literal-controlled clauses into ordinary occupation-projector supports.

checks.reason: The source gives both product and expanded forms.
All eight literal polarity patterns mark exactly one violating assignment and retain one degree-three term.

open_questions: The concrete six clauses and literal polarities used for Fig. 3 are not published.

cards.title: Routed no-fault fidelity roll-up
cards.latex: F_{\rm no\ fault}=F_{1q}^{N_{1q}}F_{2q}^{N_{2q}}\prod_{g\in\mathcal G_{\rm nat}}F_{\rm nat}^{(|g|)}F_{\rm transfer}^{N_{\rm transfer}}F_{\rm idle}^{N_{\rm idle}}\exp[-T_2^{-1}\sum_q(T_{\rm tot}-T_q^{\rm busy})]
cards.role: Combines routed gate, transfer, idle, and coherence exposures under the published Table-I factors.

checks.reason: Every multiplicative factor and timing/fidelity constant is explicit in Eq. (23) and Table I.
One storage-local phase gate gives exactly log(F_1q), zero transfers, and duration t_1q.
All 320 main proxy-route rows have log fidelity <= 0 and no-fault probability in [0,1]; the fixed-route scan adds 5,043 bounded sensitivity rows.

open_questions: Exact paper route-state counts remain unavailable; the executable route state is explicitly proxy_model.
